si.t: Singapore MDW Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Planner 2026
A planning tool to estimate the full cost of employing a Migrant Domestic Worker — NOT legal/immigration advice.
• PROFILE & INPUTS — capture helper type, salary, levy, agency fees, insurance, medical, and other costs.
• COST CALCULATOR — breaks down one-off vs recurring costs with transparent formulas.
• MONTHLY / YEARLY TCO — summarises first-year total, ongoing annual cost, and monthly equivalent.
• ACTION PLAN — checklist of requirements, timelines, and budgeting steps.
STEP 1 · Go to PROFILE & INPUTS. Fill in your arrangement details and cost assumptions.
STEP 2 · Review COST CALCULATOR and MONTHLY / YEARLY TCO. Adjust inputs to see impact.
STEP 3 · Use ACTION PLAN to track requirements and budgeting milestones.
WHAT IS OFFICIAL vs MARKET ESTIMATE vs PLANNING ASSUMPTION vs USER INPUT
• Official: MOM levy rates, security bond, medical exam requirements, work permit application fee.
• Market estimate: Agency fees, monthly salary ranges, insurance premiums (vary by provider).
• Planning assumption: Food, transport, phone, toiletries, replacement maid costs, annual leave pay.
• User input: Your specific helper profile, chosen agency, actual quotes, and budget decisions.

This tool is for financial planning only. It does NOT guarantee MOM approval, actual costs, or compliance. MOM rules and levy rates change; always verify on the MOM website and with your agency before committing.

• Levy concession reduces monthly levy from $300 to $60 (check MOM eligibility).
• Security bond ($5,000) is refundable if no violations; not a "cost" but cash flow.
• Salary range typically $550–$750 depending on experience and country.
• Agency fees range $1,500–$3,500; compare before signing.
• Insurance: MOM minimum $60,000 medical + $60,000 personal accident per year; premiums vary.
• 6-monthly medical exam required by MOM (cost ~$80 each).
• Placement loan is NOT a statutory requirement; it is a commercial arrangement between employer and agency.
